# The Sydney Morning Herald

> Australian news publication covering breaking news, politics, business, sport, culture, lifestyle, and opinion with strong Sydney and NSW reporting.

The Sydney Morning Herald is a major Australian newspaper and digital news site publishing national and international reporting, analysis, commentary, and specialist coverage across business, politics, sport, entertainment, and lifestyle.

## Main News
- [Home](https://www.smh.com.au/): Front page with major headlines, breaking news, and featured reporting.
- [Latest News](https://www.smh.com.au/latest-news): Reverse-chronological stream of the newest published stories and updates.
- [National](https://www.smh.com.au/national): Australian national news, public affairs, and major domestic developments.
- [World](https://www.smh.com.au/world): International news, geopolitics, conflicts, and global affairs coverage.
- [Sydney News](https://www.smh.com.au/national/nsw): Sydney and NSW news, local issues, transport, crime, and community reporting.
- [Coronavirus](https://www.smh.com.au/coronavirus): Coverage of COVID-19 developments, policy, health impacts, and analysis.

## Politics
- [Politics](https://www.smh.com.au/politics): Australian politics news, analysis, policy reporting, and election coverage.
- [Federal](https://www.smh.com.au/politics/federal): Federal government, parliament, ministers, legislation, and national political reporting.
- [NSW Politics](https://www.smh.com.au/politics/nsw): New South Wales state politics, policy, parliament, and government decisions.
- [Victoria Politics](https://www.smh.com.au/politics/victoria): Victorian politics, state government policy, and parliamentary coverage.
- [Queensland Politics](https://www.smh.com.au/politics/queensland): Queensland political news, elections, and state policy developments.
- [Western Australia Politics](https://www.smh.com.au/politics/western-australia): Western Australian politics, government decisions, and state affairs reporting.

## Business
- [Business](https://www.smh.com.au/business): Business news, markets, companies, economy, and workplace reporting.
- [Markets](https://www.smh.com.au/business/markets): ASX, global markets, investing, and sharemarket analysis.
- [Companies](https://www.smh.com.au/business/companies): Corporate news, mergers, earnings, executives, and company strategy.
- [The Economy](https://www.smh.com.au/business/the-economy): Inflation, interest rates, jobs, productivity, and macroeconomic reporting.
- [Banking & Finance](https://www.smh.com.au/business/banking-and-finance): Banks, superannuation, lending, regulation, and financial services coverage.
- [Workplace](https://www.smh.com.au/business/workplace): Industrial relations, employment law, wages, and workplace culture reporting.
- [Small Business](https://www.smh.com.au/business/small-business): News and advice for small business owners and operators.
- [Technology](https://www.smh.com.au/business/technology): Technology industry news, digital platforms, AI, gadgets, and innovation.

## Sport
- [Sport](https://www.smh.com.au/sport): Major sports news, live coverage, analysis, and commentary.
- [NRL](https://www.smh.com.au/sport/nrl): National Rugby League news, match coverage, and club developments.
- [AFL](https://www.smh.com.au/sport/afl): Australian Football League news, fixtures, analysis, and club reporting.
- [Cricket](https://www.smh.com.au/sport/cricket): Domestic and international cricket news, scores, and analysis.
- [Rugby Union](https://www.smh.com.au/sport/rugby-union): Rugby union news, Wallabies coverage, and competition reporting.
- [Soccer](https://www.smh.com.au/sport/soccer): A-League, Socceroos, Matildas, and international football coverage.
- [Tennis](https://www.smh.com.au/sport/tennis): Grand Slam, tour, and Australian tennis reporting.
- [Horse Racing](https://www.smh.com.au/sport/racing): Racing news, form coverage, carnival reporting, and analysis.

## Lifestyle
- [Lifestyle](https://www.smh.com.au/lifestyle): Lifestyle features spanning health, relationships, fashion, and wellbeing.
- [Good Food](https://www.smh.com.au/goodfood): Restaurant reviews, recipes, dining guides, and food features.
- [Traveller](https://www.smh.com.au/traveller): Travel inspiration, destination guides, tips, and trip planning advice.
- [Domain](https://www.smh.com.au/domain): Property news, housing market coverage, and real estate features.
- [Luxury](https://www.smh.com.au/lifestyle/luxury): Luxury goods, travel, fashion, and high-end lifestyle coverage.
- [Health](https://www.smh.com.au/lifestyle/health-and-wellness): Health, fitness, mental wellbeing, and medical lifestyle reporting.
- [Style](https://www.smh.com.au/lifestyle/style): Fashion, beauty, design, and personal style features.
- [Life & Relationships](https://www.smh.com.au/lifestyle/life-and-relationships): Family, relationships, advice, and personal life stories.

## Culture & Entertainment
- [Culture](https://www.smh.com.au/culture): Arts, books, television, film, music, and cultural commentary.
- [Movies](https://www.smh.com.au/culture/movies): Film reviews, industry news, interviews, and festival coverage.
- [TV & Radio](https://www.smh.com.au/culture/tv-and-radio): Television and radio reviews, interviews, and programming news.
- [Music](https://www.smh.com.au/culture/music): Music reviews, artist interviews, and industry reporting.
- [Books](https://www.smh.com.au/culture/books): Book reviews, author interviews, and literary coverage.
- [Art & Design](https://www.smh.com.au/culture/art-and-design): Visual arts, exhibitions, architecture, and design reporting.
- [Celebrity](https://www.smh.com.au/culture/celebrity): Celebrity news, profiles, and entertainment industry coverage.

## Opinion
- [Opinion](https://www.smh.com.au/opinion): Editorials, columns, analysis, and reader-focused commentary.
- [Columnists](https://www.smh.com.au/opinion/columnists): Opinion pieces from regular SMH writers and contributors.
- [Editorial](https://www.smh.com.au/opinion/editorial): Editorial board views on politics, policy, and public issues.
- [Cartoons](https://www.smh.com.au/opinion/cartoons): Political cartoons and illustrated commentary on current events.
- [Letters](https://www.smh.com.au/opinion/letters): Reader letters responding to news, politics, and public debate.

## Investigations & Special Coverage
- [Investigations](https://www.smh.com.au/national/investigations): In-depth investigative journalism and long-form public interest reporting.
- [Climate & Environment](https://www.smh.com.au/environment/climate-change): Climate change, energy transition, and environmental reporting.
- [Education](https://www.smh.com.au/education): Schools, universities, policy, and education system coverage.
- [Property News](https://www.smh.com.au/property-news): Housing, development, affordability, and property market reporting.
- [Weather](https://www.smh.com.au/weather): Weather forecasts, severe conditions, and climate-related updates.
- [Traffic](https://www.smh.com.au/national/nsw/traffic): Sydney and NSW traffic disruptions, transport incidents, and commuter updates.

## Puzzles, Newsletters & Account
- [Todays Paper](https://www.smh.com.au/todays-paper): Digital replica and curated edition of the day’s newspaper.
- [Crosswords & Puzzles](https://www.smh.com.au/puzzles): Interactive crosswords, quizzes, and daily puzzle games.
- [Newsletters](https://www.smh.com.au/newsletters): Email newsletters covering major topics and editorial picks.
- [Subscribe](https://subscribe.smh.com.au/): Subscription offers and digital access plans for readers.
- [My Account](https://login.smh.com.au/): Sign in and manage account access for SMH services.
